## Risk classification

Select exactly one. The checkbox declares the review gate; it does not grant
acceptance.

- [ ] Routine
- [ ] Review-sensitive
- [ ] Ambiguous

Review-sensitive changes include scientific assumptions or interpretation,
data selection, priors, calibration meaning, public interfaces, architecture,
security or access policy, substantial UI changes, and consequential
production execution. Classify uncertain scope as ambiguous.

## Human acceptance

## Review record

- [ ] Repository standards review complete.
- [ ] Scientific/specification review complete or not applicable.
- [ ] Required human approval is present or explicitly not required.
- [ ] Dependency repositories merge before dependent repositories.
- [ ] The outer workspace snapshot is updated last when component pins change.
